title: Connie Vandeman Jeffery Its Beginning to Rain CD 1993 SEALED It Is Written
descriptionText:
Connie Vandeman Jeffery - It's Beginning to Rain (It Is Written, 1993). Catalog IIW-CVJ931.

BRAND NEW AND SEALED - still in the original factory shrink wrap, never opened.

12 tracks:
1. It's Beginning To Rain
2. If Any Little Word Of Mine
3. In Times Like These
4. Thy Word
5. Always Be As A Child
6. Oh, When Shall I See Jesus
7. Baruch Hashem Adonai
8. Gentle Shepherd
9. He Was There All The Time
10. Fill My Cup, Lord
11. Softly And Tenderly (Jesus Is Calling)
12. The Lord Is Coming Are You Ready?

Distributed by It Is Written, Thousand Oaks, California. You will receive the exact sealed CD pictured.
